ModMetaData.name: Combat Stands - NPC Smart AI
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: Gives non-player humanlike pawns tactical, low-frequency AI for Combat Stands. NPCs choose stances from current melee combat context (health, local pressure, distance, target armor and target health) instead of treating all AI-usable stances as equivalent. Ranged combat is explicitly excluded because Combat Stands stances heavily penalize shooting accuracy. Does not replace ThinkTrees, pathfinding, jobs or vanilla ability authority.
